How to Participate in a Scrim

Posted by Admin.
Tutorial

Procedure :
  1. Read our Terms and Condition before participate in a scrim
  2. Choose the Scrim Event you wanted to participate in
  3. Make sure you check all the field
  4. You cannot follow more than 1 event simultaneously
  5. Click 'Participate' Button
  6. Once you click the button, you will be able to access 'Upload Center', 'Attendance', and 'Download Certificates' features
  7. You won't be able to access this tab once you have participated in a scrim, until the event ends
